children.game_version: A follow-the-leader chain game where children hold hands and perform two small hops.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm-holding motion while seated to maintain the social connection.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the chain dance without the jumps, focusing on the rhythmic sway.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to a comfortable walking pace.

signature_moves.description: Two small, rhythmic jumps performed while in a chain formation.
signature_moves.name: Plinn jumps

music_profile.sound_description: A fusion of traditional Breton melodies played on biniou and bombarde, often layered with electric guitar, harp, and steady percussion to create a driving, repetitive, and energetic sound.

basic_steps: Form a chain by holding the arms of neighbors.
Execute two small jumps in time with the music.
teaching.level_notes: Requires physical stamina due to the speed and repetitive nature of the jumps.
